title: Apple UI
script:
-- Load the UI Library
local library = loadstring(
    game:HttpGet(
        'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DozeIsOkLol/UILibarySource/refs/heads/main/Apple%20Lib%20Source'
    )
)()

-- Create the main window
local window =
    library:init('Apple UI Demo', true, Enum.KeyCode.RightShift, true)

-- ===== Section A: Basic Controls =====
window:Divider('Section A Controls')

local sectionA = window:Section('Basic Controls')

sectionA:Divider('Buttons & Labels')

sectionA:Button('Click me!', function()
    print('Button clicked!')
end)

sectionA:Label('This is a label.')

sectionA:Switch('Enable Feature?', false, function(state)
    print('Switch state:', state)
end)

sectionA:TextField('Enter Text', 'Type here...', function(text)
    print('You typed:', text)
end)

-- ===== Section B: Notifications =====
window:Divider('Section B Notifications')

local sectionB = window:Section('Notifications')

sectionB:Divider('Notification Examples')

sectionB:Button('Temporary Toast', function()
    window:TempNotify(
        'Be careful!',
        'This is a temporary notification.',
        'rbxassetid://12608259004'
    )
end)

sectionB:Button('One-Button Popup', function()
    window:Notify(
        'Heads up!',
        'This has one button.',
        'OK',
        'rbxassetid://12608259004',
        function()
            print('OK clicked')
        end
    )
end)

sectionB:Button('Two-Button Popup', function()
    window:Notify2(
        'Choose wisely',
        'This has two options.',
        'Yes',
        'No',
        'rbxassetid://12608259004',
        function()
            print('Chose YES')
        end,
        function()
            print('Chose NO')
        end
    )
end)


-- Default select the first section
sectionA:Select()
features:
This UI features;
-Dividers
-Sections
-Buttons
-Labels
-Toggles
-Textboxs
-Notifications

So overall, this UI supports buttons, toggles,  textboxs, Notifications, Dividers, and Sections.
